D.comparison: BMMs with high cluster counts, up to 64

result.effect: No numerical BIC effect size reported

cells.quote: The distribution of BIC scores across all validation runs is shown in Figure 7. A minimum can be seen around the 10-14 range corresponding to the most frequently chosen values in Figure 6. High numbers of clusters are penalised by the BIC metric if they do not provide sufficient performance improvements.
cells.note: The entry reports that most questions selected around 10–12 clusters and that high cluster counts were not optimal, but the study does not report an inferential comparison or effect size.
